risks.title: Accounting Estimates
risks.score_rationale: Accounting estimates are crucial for understanding financial statements. The 10-K identifies allowances for credit losses as a critical estimate requiring judgment on severity, frequency, and timing of credit losses.

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill impairment can have a significant impact on financial results. The company continuously assesses the recoverability of its goodwill following the divestiture of the Coats segment in January 2024.

risks.title: Litigation and Contingent Liabilities
risks.score_rationale: Litigation and contingent liabilities can impact financial results. They require ongoing judgment in assessing and provisioning for potential risks.

risks.title: Revenue Recognition
risks.score_rationale: Revenue recognition is critical for interpreting financial results, particularly for financing solutions and complex, multi-element contracts across the three segments.

risks.title: Taxes and Tax Contingencies
risks.score_rationale: Taxes and tax contingencies can impact financial results. The company operates internationally and is exposed to changes in trade policies announced in April 2025 (10% tariffs plus country-specific).

risks.title: Internal Control
risks.score_rationale: Internal control is crucial for the reliability of financial statements. The 10-K confirms that internal control over financial reporting is effective as of December 31, 2025, under COSO 2013.
